name: Radio
description: Adds a Radio channel with Dutch radio stations (NPO, Qmusic, 538, Sky Radio, regional broadcasters and more). Each station is a live audio item, so it plays in Jellyfin's music player on the web, the desktop app and the Android and iOS apps, and can be cast. Administrators choose the stations, their names and logos on the plugin page; a built-in list of tested Dutch stations is included.
overview: Listen to Dutch radio stations in every Jellyfin app.

versions.changelog: Stations now have a category, national or regional. With stations in both categories, the Radio channel shows two folders, "Landelijk" and "Regionaal"; rename them on the plugin page under Folders. The 12 regional broadcasters go into the regional folder by themselves. Existing stations move into their folder without being deleted, so favourites and playlist entries keep working. The plugin page groups the stations by category. Pick another category on a station to move it to that group; Move up and Move down work within a group. Removed from the built-in list: NPO Blend, NPO Sterren NL and Sky Radio Hits. The update removes them from your list too, unless you gave them a different stream URL. Renamed: "538 Non-Stop" is now "Radio 538 Non-Stop", so it sits next to Radio 538 in apps that sort by name. "Sky Radio Non-Stop@Work" is now "Sky Radio Non-Stop". New logos for Qmusic, Qmusic Non-Stop, Radio 538 Non-Stop, Sky Radio Non-Stop, Radio Veronica, 100% NL, SLAM!, Sublime, Omroep Brabant, Arrow Classic Rock and BNR Nieuwsradio. They are square images that also read on a dark background. The update replaces a built-in name or logo only where you kept the old one: names and logos you changed yourself stay. The channel accepts listings under its own folders only, and refuses its folders under any other channel.

New built-in stations now arrive by themselves: after an update, the plugin adds the built-in stations that are new in that version, right after their main station, the next time Jellyfin starts. Stations you removed are not brought back. Updating from 0.0.1 or 0.0.2 adds the 10 non-stop channels (8 of them switched on), unless you already added them with "Add missing Dutch stations". Casting: connect to the Cast device first, then start the station. If you switch to Cast while a station is already playing, the Cast device waits as long as you had been listening (a Jellyfin web and Cast receiver issue, explained in SETUP.md). Android TV: the Android TV app only plays local audio files, so it skips through the Radio channel. SETUP.md explains this; a Live TV route for Android TV is being tested. Test results so far are in docs/SPIKES.md.

10 non-stop channels added to the built-in list, each right after its main station: 538 Non-Stop, Qmusic Non-Stop, Sky Radio Hits, Sky Radio Non-Stop@Work, Radio 10 Non-Stop, 100% NL Non-Stop, SLAM! Non-Stop and JOE Non-Stop are switched on; Radio 10 Soul & Jazz and BNR Business Beats are in the list but switched off. Every stream was checked and its format measured on 2026-10-13 (all MP3, 128 kbps). Already installed? Open the plugin page, press "Add missing Dutch stations" and then Save. The new channels are placed right after their main station. Radio Veronica and Sublime have no non-stop channel, so none was added for them.

Test build, published as a GitHub pre-release and installable from this repository's manifest, to run the checks in docs/SPIKES.md before v0.1.0. A **Radio** channel (Home, My Media) in which every station is a live audio item. It plays in Jellyfin's music player on the   web; Jellyfin Desktop and the Android and iOS apps are being verified. 44 Dutch stations built in, 33 of them switched on:   - NPO, the national commercial stations and 12 regional public broadcasters.   - Every stream was checked on 2026-10-13 and its format read from the stream itself.   - Only MP3 streams: Jellyfin cannot convert live AAC. A plugin page to manage the stations:   - Switch stations on and off, rename them, change logos and add your own.   - Reorder them; the apps follow the page's order.   - **Test** checks a stream URL and measures its format.   - A StreamTheWorld node URL is replaced by the stable redirect URL.   - Playlists (.m3u, .pls) and AAC streams are refused with an explanation.   - A changed stream URL must be tested again before it can be saved. Renamed stations and new logos reach the existing items, so favourites keep working. Diagnostics on the plugin page:   - Which stations Jellyfin would serve, and as what.   - Users who cannot see the channel: no channel access, forced transcoding of remote sources, or unrated channel content blocked. Options:   - Don't redirect apps (Android Auto) to the station; the server streams it instead.   - Hide the channel from chosen users, such as a living-room Android TV account. The Radio channel refuses requests for folders inside it (it has none).
